source: Minchat Shai on Gen 32:31 ('the first is פניאל, the second פנואל — so the Masorah, with its sign')
claim_en: THE FACE-NAME'S CHANGED LETTER: Jacob names the place פניאל ('the FACE OF GOD,' 32:31 — 'for I have seen God face to face') with a YOD at its heart; one verse later, as the sun rises on his limp, the Torah writes it פנואל with a VAV (32:32, builder-checked) — the naming and the morning spelled one letter apart, exactly as the Masorah rules the order: first yod, then vav.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 32:15 ('עזים מאתים — the whole verse ends in mem, like the offering-verses; eight mems, against the eight kings who reigned in Edom before a king reigned in Israel; another reading: all the beasts sent were blemished, unfit for the altar')
claim_en: THE GIFT-VERSE OF EIGHT MEMS: every word of the tribute's first verse — 'two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams' (32:15) — ends in the letter mem, eight closing mems in a row (DB-checked), which the Kitzur sets against the EIGHT KINGS who reigned in Edom before any king in Israel (the ledger of gen_59's span): Esau's tribute sealed with Esau's king-count.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 32:10 ('האמר — two, both lean, their signs: WHO-SAID-to-me return-to-your-land, and WHO-SAID-of-his-father-and-mother; the Ramah: every like-form in the Torah lean')
claim_en: THE TWO LEAN WHO-SAIDs: האמר ('YHWH, WHO SAID to me: return to your land,' 32:10 — the prayer quoting the command of 31:3) stands exactly twice in the Torah, both lean — here, and Levi's blessing 'WHO SAID of his father and mother, I have not seen them' (Deut 33:9): the prayer's quoted promise and the Levite's severed kinship, spelled as one pair.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 32:26 ('יכל — lean, proven from the Shelach Masorah; the Ramah: the CAN of we-surely-can alone is written full vav in the Torah')
claim_en: THE ONE FULL CAN: at the wrestling — 'he saw that he COULD not prevail against him' (32:26) — the can-word יכל runs lean, as at Joseph's breakdown (45:1) and the cloud-filled Tabernacle Moses could not enter (Exod 40:35, all three builder-checked); the Torah's ONE full יכול belongs to Caleb: 'we surely CAN go up' (Num 13:30). Every could-not lean; the one whole CAN is the faith-cry.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 32:10 ('ואיטיבה — full, two yods, the Masorah marking NONE LIKE IT; the Hilleli full against the Yerushalmi; so the Ramah explicitly') + Kitzur 32:10 ('full of yod: he prayed that the TEN trials of Abraham stand for him')
claim_en: THE PROMISE WRITTEN OVERFULL: ואיטיבה ('and I WILL SURELY DO GOOD with you,' 32:10 — the promise Jacob holds up in prayer) — written full with BOTH yods, the Masorah's none-like-it, the Hilleli and the Ramah against the Yerushalmi's lean form; the Kitzur reads the extra yod (the ten-letter) as Abraham's ten trials invoked into the promise.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 32:19 ('שלוחה — the Masorah: three, two lean and one full; the Naphtali one lean; an old scroll-manual's lean variant here is overruled') + Kitzur 32:19 (the sent-hand reading)
claim_en: THE SENT-GIFT FULL, THE SENT-HIND LEAN: שלוחה ('it is a gift SENT to my lord, to Esau,' 32:19) — written full with its vav, while its Torah sister runs lean: 'Naphtali is a hind SENT forth' (49:21, builder-checked; the third member, Ezekiel's outstretched hand, named outside): the Masorah's two-lean-one-full landing with the gift as the whole one, against the old book's lean variant.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 32:12 ('הצילני נא מיד — the initials hint at HAMAN, who went out to strike mother with children')
claim_en: THE ENEMY IN THE INITIALS: הצילני נא מיד ('DELIVER me, please, from the hand of my brother,' 32:12) — the three words' initial letters carry the letters of המן (Haman, DB-checked as a multiset): the Kitzur reads the prayer against the striker of 'mother with children' armed already inside Jacob's own fear of exactly that fate (32:12's own closing words).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 32:25 ('ויאבק איש עמו — the final letters spell קשו, for the house of Esau shall be STRAW; and איש עמו in gematria is עשו אדום')
claim_en: STRAW AT THE END OF THE WRESTLING: ויאבק איש עמו ('and a man WRESTLED with him,' 32:25) — the three words' final letters spell קשו ('straw,' DB-checked in order), the Kitzur hearing Obadiah's verdict 'the house of Esau shall be straw' sealed at the clause's ends; and the letters of איש עמו ('a man with him') sum to 427, the count of עשו אדום ('Esau, Edom' — builder-checked): the adversary named twice inside the grapple's own letters.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 32:23 ('ויקם בלילה הוא — one of the FOUR the-Masorah lists where the sense expects ההוא and the letter writes הוא; the signs at Vayera and I Samuel 19')
claim_en: THE NIGHT THE LETTER LEAVES BARE, AGAIN: הוא of the crossing-night ('and he rose THAT night and took his two wives,' 32:23) — the sense expects the the-prefixed form; the letter writes it bare, another of the Masorah's FOUR such stations (with Lot's elder daughter's night, 19:33, and the mandrake night, 30:16, both already in the corpus): the expected-form class gains its third in-span member on the night of the wrestling.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 32:17 ('ורוח — two in the Masorah: a SPACE you shall set between herd and herd, and RELIEF shall rise for the Jews (Esther 4:14): a hint that the generations to come send their tribute to the princes')
claim_en: THE BREATHING-SPACE AND THE RELIEF: ורוח ('and a SPACE you shall set between herd and herd,' 32:17) — of the four Torah tokens of these letters, this alone is the breathing-space noun (segol-pointed; the other three are the WIND of creation, of the locusts, and of the quails, builder-checked): the Masorah pairs it with Esther's רוח ('RELIEF shall rise for the Jews,' 4:14, named) — the space Jacob sets before Esau read as the relief set before every later Haman.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 32:16 ('ועירם — the ayin with SHEVA ALONE in the precise manuscripts; so the Michlol, Livyat Chen, and Rav Pealim')
claim_en: THE AYIN HOLDS THE LINE: ועירם ('twenty she-asses and ten FOALS,' 32:16) — the ayin with plain sheva (the silent half-vowel) exactly as all the precise books rule: where resh, tzadi, lamed, and qof keep splitting into the compound half-vowel (the characterized law's eleven stations), the guttural ayin stands bare here as at ויעתק (26:22) — the class's consonant boundary confirmed a second time.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 32:11 ('כי במקלי — the bet SOFT in all the books, against Rav Pealim') + Kitzur ('במקלי in gematria: יעקב — with my body alone') + MS 32:27 ('אשלחך — meteg on the shin in the precise manuscripts and Ben Asher's variant-lists')
claim_en: THE STAFF AND THE STROKE, AS RULED: במקלי ('with MY STAFF I crossed this Jordan,' 32:11) — the bet soft with all the books against Rav Pealim's dagesh, and the staff-word's letters sum to 182, the count of יעקב himself (builder-checked): the Kitzur's 'with my body alone' carried in the arithmetic; and at the dawn's אשלחך ('I will not LET YOU GO,' 32:27) the ruled meteg (the small stress-stroke) stands on the shin in the stream exactly as Ben Asher's lists require.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 32:3 ('מחנה אלהים זה — HOLY, tractate Soferim') + 32:29 ('כי שרית עם אלהים — some of the sages read it holy, some profane; Bereshit Rabbah and Chullin, the sinew chapter')
claim_en: THE CAMP'S HOLY NAME AND THE WRESTLER'S DISPUTED ONE (classification layer, uninstrumented): tractate Soferim rules the אלהים of 'this is God's CAMP' (32:3) HOLY, while the אלהים of the renaming — 'for you have striven WITH GOD and with men' (32:29) — the sages themselves divide, some holy, some profane (Bereshit Rabbah; Chullin's sinew chapter): SNAPSHOT's stream carries no holy/profane layer — stations nine and ten filed unsettled.
